direction: an edge runs source -> target, as wv link <source> <target> --type=<type> writes it

enforcement.write: wv link refuses an edge that breaks an invariant (policy rule edge_write_invariants); wv block refuses a blocks cycle (block_graph_acyclic)
enforcement.report: wv doctor lists stored edges that break one; existing violations are reported, never refused on read (ontology D4)
enforcement.query: wv_edge_violations_sql in scripts/lib/wv-db.sh, shared by the write check and the report

common.rule: both endpoints are nodes in the graph

invariants.rule: the target does not already reach the source over blocks edges
the target does not already reach the source over implements edges
target.created_at >= source.created_at, or the source's metadata.superseded_by names the target
a memory source carries metadata.superseded_by = target

resolves.meaning: Links a task or fix with its finding handoff

invariants.rule: source or target has kind finding, or a finding/gap text prefix (finding(, Finding:, gap()

closure.rule: a node closes only when each open implements child is parked (metadata.deferred with a deferred_reason), linked by a resolves edge, or has another implements parent still open
closure.report: wv doctor lists closed parents over such children
